summary: Replace the CLI-repo trust anchor in merge-if-eligible so adopters running pipeline-cli from the plugin cache can land PRs

options.description: Read .ai-sdlc/agent-role.yaml and the task file from the TARGET repo via the GitHub API at the resolved main sha; cwd must be a work tree whose origin is the PR's repo; no disk policy read (recommended)
git fetch origin main in the cwd repo and read the policy blob from origin/main; cwd origin must match the PR repo
Keep the current anchor; merge-if-eligible stays unsupported outside this repo's dogfood layout

body: resolveTrustedMainRoot (pipeline-cli/src/governance/merge-if-eligible.ts:148-172) anchors policy trust on the main checkout of the repo containing the running CLI. A plugin-cache install is not a git repo, so every adopter invocation fails closed ('could not verify the main checkout of the repo containing this CLI'; ai-sdlc-io report 2026-10-14). The anchor's intent (an agent must not cd into a repo it controls to read a lenient policy) must be kept by the replacement. Implementing task: AISDLC-897. Requested by ai-sdlc-io DEC-0008.
